shape_and_identity.calibration: n admitted bins in original enumeration order; zero-based SourceOrdinals. NaN pairs skipped, infinities retained; identity two points, axes[0,1],unit.2.
shape_and_identity.symmetry: floor(n/2) upper-tail X/lower-tail Y, descending paired sorted slots; two-point historical reference; Core axis engine reused. Windows still sorts original aliased input at the original time. No worksheet row is invented.
shape_and_identity.ecdf: Input length plus zero/one/two constant-Y extension endpoints. Invalid/null/mismatched source retains original array values; public payload snapshots. Private Windows no-extension/invalid aliases preserved.
shape_and_identity.ladder: Label anchors returned in original input order after stable value/index spreading; explicit numeric bounds/separation. Host obtains physical measurements.
shape_and_identity.bullet: Explicit chart width/height plus current numerical appearance values; immutable drawing/row layout scalars; historical clip and min-size errors retained. Band/bar/target arithmetic remains OPEN.
shape_and_identity.sankey: Explicit chart size and stage/legend counts, immutable measured layout, clipped maps and ordered stage centres. Original flow solver unchanged; ribbon/node anchors and label preparation remain OPEN.
shape_and_identity.references: Exactly two ordered endpoints; affine uses intercept+slope*x without refitting; identity/horizontal/vertical copy-safe arrays.
shape_and_identity.spc: Post-extents empty[0,1], constant10%/other7% padding and existing natural-zero/proportion clamp; accepted ten-channel/mask/stage projection unchanged. Detailed series and annotations reserved36.
shape_and_identity.love: Existing accepted projection retains order/absolute-SMD/masks/threshold/maxX; new finite-series predicate and two-point threshold only. No guard correction.
shape_and_identity.timing: Integer milliseconds to centiseconds using original max(1, CInt(Math.Round(max(0,ms)/10))). Encoding/file/GDI+ stays Windows.
